decision.explanation: The provided sources present conflicting claims about which political party(s) Marcoux belonged to. D1S3 and D2S6 indicate that Marcoux was a Liberal by background who later joined the Liberal-Progressives. D3S3 states he was a Conservative by background and remained loyal to the party. D4S2 refers to a different Marcoux (Yvon Marcoux), who was a member of the Quebec Liberal Party. These are distinct referents (E1 vs. E2) and/or conflicting claims about the same referent. All are valid under the rules, so they are preserved.
